title: S5 capability descriptor (V1)
description: ML-DEVOS-RFC-017 §2. A policy artifact, not a grant. resource_scope uses the bounded V1 grammar; literals/stems must be canonical per the provider's contract (enforced by validate-capability-policy.mjs, which also enforces the §8 sensitive-tier rule at load time only). A descriptor absent from a newer policy version is not grantable to new attempts after supersession; an attempt already pinned to the older version keeps it until expiry or live revocation.

project.description: S3 project shape, or "*" for a Sentinel-wide descriptor.

provider.description: "future" is reserved and not usable in V1.

items.description: Exact literal, one trailing "/*" prefix wildcard, or bare "*".

expiry.description: UTC instant at which the descriptor stops being valid, or null. null is not "forever": the descriptor is not grantable to new attempts after supersession, and live revocation still applies.

credential_class.description: A credential CLASS name, never a value, path, or hint where a secret lives.

consequence_tier.description: Policy-authoring classification only; never an evaluate() input (RFC-017 §8).
